abilities.name: Intimidating Motivation (Once per battle round, per army)
abilities.text:
In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit's move, you can select one friendly **ORKS** unit within 6" of this unit. That unit:

abilities.name: Krushin' Impetus

- For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 **mortal wound**.
